svg.title: Braking energy grows with speed squared
svg.desc: Parabola of translational kinetic energy for 1400 kg. 50 km/h corresponds to 135 kJ and 100 km/h to 540 kJ.

g.text: Twice the speed, four times the energy
Hypothetical 1,400 kg car. E = ½mv²; rotational energy omitted.
